title: Filipino-Style Ricotta Pancakes
description: A unique fusion of Japanese and Filipino flavors, these ricotta pancakes are a delightful twist on traditional Japanese pancakes.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the ricotta, filipino, flour, egg, jazzy, and curry powder.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Drop the mixture by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings.
